title: renderApplication
summary: Render the optional Preact application document and hydration snapshot.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass request, server routes, root module, browser entry URL and optional { nonce, earlyHydration } for streaming scripts under CSP.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns a Promise<Response> with a streaming HTML body, or a redirect/resource response. Root and matched-route loaders start concurrently. Top-level loader promises determine critical data and HTTP status; nested promises remain deferred.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Render the optional Preact application document and hydration snapshot.

sections.title: Page actions and hydration
sections.body: For a page POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, the server runs the action once before loading the page data. JSON action results become snapshot.actionData, so useActionData reads the same result during server rendering and after hydration. A data(value, { status, headers }) result preserves its status and response headers in the HTML response, including validation statuses and cookies. Returned action errors populate snapshot.error for the route boundary. Redirects and non-JSON HTTP responses are returned directly without rendering a document.

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: Requires preact-render-to-string >=6.8.1. Wrap deferred fields in Suspense and Await to stream fallbacks before values settle. By default, hydration starts after the document completes. Set earlyHydration: true to send an initial snapshot with promise references and hydrate the shell while deferred values stream independently. Rejected deferred fields retain Await errorElement behavior. Errors after headers have been sent cannot change the HTTP status. Vite development HTML transformation buffers; production Node/Express hosting streams. Each request router is disposed when its stream completes or is cancelled.
